why_agent_cannot: connect a wallet and approve the signature
what_human_must_do: Connect a burner wallet and approve the signature yourself.
steps_from_source: Read the Hashcats docs and check the live numbers on the homepage first: the entry price, the epoch and when the last cat was mined.
Set up a wallet on Robinhood Chain with enough ETH for the entry price and gas.
Open the Mine page and connect the wallet. A solution you find works only for your own address.
Choose CPU or GPU mining, check the cost of the next cat and start.

When your browser finds a hash, confirm the transaction, which sends the entry price. The docs say a solution "dies with the next cat, or in about 25 seconds", so a mint can fail through no fault of yours.
